regions.today: Remaining dry and bright this evening with hazy sunshine and generally light to moderate southeasterly breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry for most tonight with occasional clear spells. Turning cloudier from the south towards dawn. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 14 degrees, with a light to moderate southeasterly breeze, freshening towards morning.
regions.tomorrow: Windy tomorrow, with southeasterly winds increasing fresh to strong and turning gusty, reaching near gale force in the evening. Some early bright spells, but further cloud with patchy rain and drizzle will develop in places. More persistent and locally heavy rain will spread from the southwest later. Mild and humid, with highs of 17 to 20 degrees.
